name: flash_eraseprogram
description: FLASH_EraseProgram: sectors 2 to 7 erased (two of 16 KiB at 250 ms, one of 64 KiB at 550 ms, three of 128 KiB at 1 s each, DS10693's typical times at x32), then 480 KiB programmed a word at a time (16 us each, about 2 s), the core waiting on the flash throughout; every word read back as DATA_32 turns LD1 on near 6.1 s. LD2 (a word wrong) and LD3 (an error) stay dark.
